title: Brightsmile 1 · Discovery
description: Rahul names lost after-hours bookings and a trust problem, not a budget problem. RingHawk is already in the building.

transcript.speaker: Rahul
transcript.text: no problem honestly i've been meaning to look at this for a while so your timing is decent

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.text: tell me what's happening today you're running five locations on ringhawk right

transcript.speaker: Rahul
transcript.text: yeah well fiverr on ringhawk and have been for about three years and look the system works until it doesn't cause drop mid transfer between locations at least a few times a day now

transcript.speaker: Rahul
transcript.text: after hours is the real bleed anything after six just rings out and goes to a voice mail nobody checks until morning we lose maybe ten bookings a week that way a cleaning patient calls at seven nobody answers they

transcript.text: book with whoever picks up the phone

transcript.text: that's real money at five locations what have you tried

transcript.text: we asked ring hog for after hours routing last year the support tickets go nowhere you wait four days and get a reply asking you to restart the router i'm done filing them

transcript.text: understood can i ask about budget just so i don't waste your time later

transcript.text: we do not have a budget problem honestly it's a trust problem i got burned once switching software and i'm not doing that dance again without proof it works

transcript.text: what is your ringhawk renewal look like

transcript.text: we want to my office manager keeps asking about text reminders but i keep hearing letters like tcpa and i don't want to be the test case so today we just don't text at all

transcript.speaker: Rahul
transcript.text: alright do it thursday before the lunch rush and keep it practical i don't need a slideshow

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.text: thursday tiz i'll bring the routing demo and the texting flow no slides
